benchmark: AgentHarm (ai-safety-institute/AgentHarm) tool surface, target_functions as ground truth, labels from an independent model
reading: Declarations are synthesized from the ground-truth labels, so the 'accurate' arm is an UPPER BOUND on what coverage buys: it assumes the integrator declares correctly.

The mislabel arm prices the opposite failure: the manifest tier is AUTHORITATIVE, so a verb wrongly declared reversible is a false negative the guard produces with confidence, overriding heuristics that would have caught it.
Coverage is sampled uniformly at random; a real integrator who declares the destructive verbs first does better at the same coverage, and one who declares only reads does worse.
Static scorer: one call per function, no agent, no session history.
